method: For each of the five frozen test questions and each strategy, read all three retrieved chunk texts in traces_test.jsonl, compare them with the question, expected answer and PDF source page. Label 0 when evidence for the requested claim is absent, 1 when related but incomplete, and 2 when enough to answer with a traceable source. Retrieval similarity scores were not used to choose the labels.
possible_bias: The AI reviewer saw the gold and retrieval outputs. The student should inspect and confirm these labels; they are not represented as an independent human assessment.
